as_given.why: follows latest's docstring in the repo: returns the winner as given, without the v

semver_prerelease.why: ranks -hotfix below the plain version, as semver ranks a pre-release

calendar_numeric.why: compares 2023.4 by its numbers, so the calendar release beats every X.Y.Z

hotfix_first.why: tie-breaks in the wrong order: any hotfix outranks the next plain version (1.10.0-hotfix over 1.10.1)
